item.title: Eclipse v2.3.0
item.description:
Eclipse 2.3.0 | Eclipse-unsigned-v2.3.0-20261020-090254
Additions:
-Deep tracker library integration option (AniList, MAL, Trakt) -Simkl Tracking (Will NOT get deep tracking integration due to free tier limits) -Ratings and Notes setting -Concurrent download controls -Background HLS downloading (iOS 26+ only) -Subtitle delay -Dolby Atmos and Dolby Vision support -epub support (experimental) -Light novel reader rework
Fixes/Changes (fixes are not guaranteed, different devices behave differently) :
-Fixed mpv backgrounding audio desync, it should take a sec to recover. -Fixed mpv downstream blowing up -Changed Alt poster and season building to be more accurate, tested 220 anime, and 100 western shows -Fixed unaired episode hiding -Fixed System calendar crash, app now enforces Gregorian calendar -Fixed Ratings and Notes getting lost -Removed Performance mode and watch together. No longer needed/wasn't popular. Perf mode is enforced On -Ratings and notes can now be assigned per season rather than the whole show -Subtitle edit fixes -Language filters are now hardcoded values instead of user inputted ones -Fixed Reader mode library importing not being able to connect a source -Rearranged settings to push more important ones higher -Changed some Auto Mode logic -Fixed audio name detection -Fixed subtitle name detection -Double tap to seek no longer brings up the player UI
As always, use GitHub issues or the discord for requests or bug reports.
